description: This file defines extension methods for integrating Azure Key Vault as a configuration source within an OrchardCore project, including methods for adding Key Vault to various builder types and handling configuration retrieval and validation.

classes.name: AzureKeyVaultConfigurationExtension
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to add Azure Key Vault as a configuration source in OrchardCore.

methods.name: AddOrchardCoreAzureKeyVault
methods.description: Extension method to add Azure Key Vault to IHostBuilder, IWebHostBuilder, or ConfigurationManager, with optional token credential.

methods.name: AddOrchardCoreAzureKeyVault (private)
methods.description: Internal method to configure Azure Key Vault using IConfigurationBuilder, IConfiguration, and optional token credential.

methods.name: GetVaultHostUri
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the vault URI from configuration, constructing it from VaultURI or KeyVaultName settings.
